description: HALO AI (Health, Act, Log, Observe) is a prototype mission-support workspace designed for astronauts facing space stressors like microgravity and radiation. It combines daily vitals check-ins, cognitive practice tasks, and NASA-TLX workload tracking into one simple dashboard. Grounded in NASA’s Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) and simulated NYMPHA telemetry, HALO pairs mission logs with its AI companion, Yuki, to turn raw health observations into clear, human-centered insights.
